# PanelkaPack research inputs

Source: Kureca, https://kureca.itch.io/panelka-pack (CC0 as declared by author). Extracted from the user-provided original ZIP. Manifest records source member names, original dimensions and SHA-256, output dimensions and hashes. Seven panel photographs and six brick maps are unchanged; high-resolution door, ventilation and slate pairs were resampled to matching 512px-class dimensions; downsampled normals renormalized. Original archive remains outside Git. No commercial wParallax content included. Photographs include baked illumination and facade panel borders; use calibrated crops and explicit masks, not a naive repeated whole-panel texture. Normal convention and roughness interpretation require validation. These inputs are staged separately from the roof revision PR so its single CI can finish without cancellation; no runtime integration or visual acceptance implied.
